name: Meta

capex_guidance.sentence: We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $130-145 billion, narrowed from our prior outlook of $125-145 billion.

summary: Meta expects 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, of $130-145 billion, narrowed from its prior outlook of $125-145 billion; second-quarter capital expenditures were $31.08 billion.
